description: This file is a controller class for managing marketing campaigns in the admin panel of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It handles listing, creating, editing, deleting, and reporting on marketing campaigns, including filtering and pagination functionalities.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller class for marketing management within OpenCart admin, providing CRUD operations, report generation, and autocomplete functionality for marketing campaigns.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for displaying the marketing overview page with filters and breadcrumbs.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles the request to output the list of marketing campaigns.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filtered list of marketing campaigns with pagination and prepares data for the list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a marketing campaign.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes saving of a new or existing marketing campaign, including validation and response handling.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles deletion of selected marketing campaigns.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report related to a specific marketing campaign.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Fetches report data for a marketing campaign, including associated customer/IP info and pagination.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides an autocomplete list of marketing campaigns based on filter inputs.
